Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:11:1.hebrew: שבועת שוא - על העמוד של אבן שהוא של אבן, שבועת שקר — על העמוד של אבן שהוא של זהב — אע"ג דלאו רשע דחמס הוא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:11:1.english: An oath in vain - [Swearing] about a stone pillar that it is of stone; [or] a false oath — about a stone pillar that it is of gold — even though he is not a "wicked person of violence" [ḥamas, i.e., guilty of monetary transgression].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:13:1.hebrew: ומלוי רבית - הני אין, אבל אוכל נבילות להכעיס — לא. ומיהו, לתיאבון כגזלנין ומלוי ריבית דמו, דמשום ממון קעביד; הלכך, חשוד למישקל שוחדא ואסהודי שקרא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:13:1.english: And those who lend with interest - [Only] these, yes, but one who eats carcasses to express insolence [is] not [disqualified]. However, [one who eats them] due to appetite is like robbers and lenders with interest, for he acts for the sake of money; therefore, he is suspected of taking a bribe and testifying falsely.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:14:1.hebrew: בדיני נפשות - שכיון שהוחשד לחמור, הוחשד לקל:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:14:1.english: In capital cases - For since he has become suspect regarding the severe [matter], he is suspect regarding the lenient [matter].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:15:1.hebrew: אביי כר' מאיר - דהיינו נמי מקולא לחומרא: דאוכל נבילות רע לשמים ואינו רע לבריות, אבל מעיד שקר בממון — רע לשמים ורע לבריות, שהרי מפסידן בעדותו; וקא פסיל ליה אביי משום נבילות לעדות ממון:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:15:1.english: Abaye is in accordance with Rabbi Meir - This too is [an inference of] from lenient to strict: for one who eats carcasses is wicked toward Heaven and is not wicked toward people, whereas one who testifies falsely in monetary [matters] is wicked toward Heaven and wicked toward people, for he causes them a loss through his testimony; and [yet] Abaye disqualifies him on account of [eating] carcasses from monetary testimony.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:16:1.hebrew: אליבא דרבי יוסי דכ"ע לא פליגי - כלומר, אביי ודאי לאו כרבי יוסי מצי לאוקומא למילתיה, דכיון דאמר רבי יוסי: ממון לנפשות לא מיפסל — ואף על גב דממון הוי רע לשמים ורע לבריות — וכל שכן דמנבלה לממון לא אפסיל; ולאביי, על כרחיה תנאי היא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:16:1.english: According to Rabbi Yosei, everyone agrees - That is to say, Abaye certainly cannot establish his statement according to Rabbi Yosei, since Rabbi Yosei says [that a conspiring witness in] monetary [cases] is not disqualified for capital [cases] — and even though [testifying falsely regarding] monetary matters is bad toward Heaven and bad toward people — and all the more so, from [eating] non-kosher meat to [testifying regarding] monetary matters, one would not be disqualified; and [so] for Abaye, of necessity it is [a dispute between] Tannaim.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:16:2.hebrew: כי פליגי אליבא דר' מאיר - כלומר, לרבא לא תוקמא כתנאי, דרבא אפילו אליבא דר"מ אמר למילתיה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:16:2.english: When they disagree, [it is] according to Rabbi Meir - That is to say, for Rava, do not establish [it] as [a dispute between] Tannaim, for Rava stated his statement even according to Rabbi Meir.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:18:1.hebrew: האי - דקתני אלו הגזלנין ומלוי ריבית, דמשמע: אבל אוכלי נבילות כשרין:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:18:1.english: This - That which was taught: "These are the robbers and lenders with interest," which implies: But eaters of non-kosher meat are fit [witnesses].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:18:2.hebrew: ר' יוסי היא - דאמר מקולתא לחמירתא לא, ויחידאה הוא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:18:2.english: It is Rabbi Yosei - For he said [that we do] not [apply disqualification] from a lenient [matter] to a stringent [matter], and he is an individual [opinion].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:1:1.hebrew: עד זומם - העיד בניסן, והוזם בתשרי על עדות זו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:1:1.english: A conspiring witness - [For example, he] testified in Nisan, and was rendered a conspiring witness in Tishrei regarding this testimony:

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:1:2.hebrew: למפרע - כל עדיות שהעיד מניסן ואילך פסולין, שהרי משהעיד עדות זו הוא רשע:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:1:2.english: Retroactively - All testimonies that he gave from Nisan onward are invalid, for from [the time] he gave this testimony, he is a wicked person:

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:1:3.english: From that point forward - From [the time] he was established as a conspiring witness.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:21:1.hebrew: לכהיוהו לעיניה - ינקרו את עיניו, דבטלו מיתות ב"ד, והאי קנסא קא עבדינן ביה, דב"ד מכין ועונשין שלא מן התורה. וי"א: יטלו ממונו ויתנו ליורשין; ויש אומרים: שמתא. וראשון עיקר:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:21:1.english: Let them dim his eyes - They shall gouge out his eyes, for court-ordered capital punishment has ceased, and we impose this penalty upon him, as a court may strike and punish not in accordance with Torah law. And some say: They shall seize his property and give it to the heirs. And some say: [It means] excommunication. And the first [explanation] is primary.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:3:1.hebrew: חידוש הוא - שנפסלין שנים בשביל שנים שאומרים "עמנו הייתם", דמאי חזית דסמכת אהני? סמוך אהני! אלא גזירת הכתוב הוא. הלכך, אין לך בו אלא משעת חידוש ואילך — משעה שהוזם:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:3:1.english: It is a novelty - That two [witnesses] are disqualified on account of two [witnesses] who say, "You were with us"; for what did you see to rely on these? Rely on those! Rather, it is a scriptural decree. Therefore, you have in its regard only from the time of [its] novelty and onward — from the time that he was refuted as a conspiring witness.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:4:1.hebrew: פסידא דלקוחות - שלקחו שדות על פיו, וחתם בשטרא מניסן עד תשרי, ועדיין לא היה ידוע שהוא פסול:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:4:1.english: Loss to purchasers - Who purchased fields based on his [testimony], and he signed on the deed from Nisan until Tishrei, and it was not yet known that he was disqualified.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:5:1.english: What is [the difference] between them - Between these two reasons of Rava.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:5:2.hebrew: תרי בחד - תרי כיתות שהעידו בכת זו, שנים אמרו לכל אחד: עמנו הייתם במקום פלוני. חידוש ליכא, פסידא דלקוחות איכא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:5:2.english: Two about one - [Where] two sets [of witnesses] testified against this set [of witnesses]: two [witnesses] said to each one, “You were with us in such-and-such a place.” There is no novelty [here], [yet] there is loss to purchasers.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:5:3.hebrew: א"נ דפסלינהו - להני תרי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:5:3.english: Alternatively, where they disqualified them - [That is,] these two [witnesses].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:5:4.hebrew: בגזלנותא - שהעידו שגזלנין הם על גזילה שגזלו בניסן. חידוש ליכא, דהא מילתא אחריני קמסהדי; אבל פסידא דלקוחות איכא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:5:4.english: By robbery - Where [witnesses] testified that they are robbers, regarding a robbery that they committed in Nisan. There is no novel ruling [here], as they are testifying about another matter; but there is [a concern for] financial loss to purchasers.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:7:1.hebrew: יע"ל קג"ם - יאוש שלא מדעת — באלו מציאות (ב"מ ד' כא:); עד זומם — הכא; לחי העומד מאיליו — בפ"ק דעירובין (ד' טו.); קידושין שלא נמסרו לביאה — בהאיש מקדש (קדושין ד' נא.); גילוי דעת בגיטין — בהשולח גט (גיטין ד' לד.); מומר אוכל נבילות להכעיס — לקמן:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:7:1.english: Ye’al Kagam - Despair without knowledge is discussed in the chapter “Elu Metzi’ot” (Bava Metzia 21b); a conspiring witness is discussed here; a side post that stands on its own is discussed in the first chapter of Eruvin (15a); betrothal that was not given for consummation is discussed in the chapter “Ha’ish Mekadesh” (Kiddushin 51a); revealing one’s intent regarding bills of divorce is discussed in the chapter “HaSholach Get” (Gittin 34a); an apostate who eats carcasses to provoke is discussed below.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:8:1.hebrew: ה"ג מומר אוכל נבילות לתיאבון דברי הכל פסול - דכיון דמשום ממון קעביד, דהא שכיחא בזול טפי מדהיתירא, הוה ליה כרשע דחמס, ופסול לעדות:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 27a:8:1.english: This is the reading: A transgressor who eats carcasses due to appetite, everyone agrees is disqualified - For since he does [so] for the sake of money — as it is commonly found more cheaply than permitted [meat] — he is considered like a wicked person of violence, and is disqualified from [bearing] testimony.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 27a:12:1.hebrew: מאי שבועות שבועות דעלמא - תימה: ליתיב אביי לרבא מפרק כל הנשבעין (שבועות דף מד:), דתנן: "ושכנגדו חשוד על השבועה — נשבע ונוטל", וקא בעי למימר: דאפי' שבועת שוא, אלמא לא בעינן רשע דחמס; מגו דחשוד אשבועת שוא, דרע לשמים, חשוד נמי אשבועת ממון — דרע לשמים הוי רע לבריות? וי"ל: דלא דמי, דהתם מן השבועה הוא רע לשמים, ועכשיו שכופר ממון לחבירו הוה ליה נמי רע לבריות; הלכך מיראת שבועה לא יודה, דכבר רע לשמים הוא, ובהאי שבועה נמי ליכא כ"א רע לשמים כדפרישית. אבל הכא גבי עדות, אע"ג דהוא רע לשמים משום שבועת שוא, לא יעיד עדות שקר להיות רע לבריות. [וע"ע תוס' שבועות מו: ד"ה ואפילו]:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 27a:12:1.english: What is [the meaning of] "oaths"? Oaths in general - [This is] puzzling: Let Abaye raise an objection to Rava from the chapter [entitled] Kol HaNishba'in (Shevuot 44b), as we learned in a mishna: "[If] the one opposing him is suspected of [taking a false] oath, [the claimant] takes an oath and collects," and [the Gemara there] sought to say that [this applies] even [to one suspected of taking] an oath in vain! Evidently, we do not require [him to be] a wicked person [guilty] of a monetary transgression [rasha deḥamas]! [For does it mean that] since he is suspected of an oath in vain, which is evil toward Heaven, he is also suspected of a monetary oath, [as one who is] evil toward Heaven is [also considered capable of being] evil toward [his fellow] creatures? And it can be answered that [these cases] are not comparable: for there, with regard to the oath [itself], he is evil toward Heaven, and now that he denies [owing] money to his fellow, he is also evil toward [his fellow] creatures; therefore, he will not admit [the truth] out of fear of an oath, since he is already evil toward Heaven, and in this oath as well there is only [an offense of being] evil toward Heaven, as I explained. However, here with regard to testimony, even though he is evil toward Heaven on account of [taking] an oath in vain, he would not bear false witness [so as] to be evil toward [his fellow] creatures. [And see further Tosafot, Shevuot 46b, s.v. Ve'afilu].

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 27a:1:1.hebrew: רבא אמר מכאן ולהבא הוא נפסל - תימה: הא דאמר בפ' חזקת הבתים (ב"ב ד' לא. ושם): "זה אומר של אבותי ואכלתיה שני חזקה, וזה אומר כו'" — האי אייתי סהדי דאבהתיה היא ואכלה שני חזקה, והאי אייתי סהדי דאכלה שני חזקה; וקאמר התם: "אוקי חזקה בהדי חזקה, ואוקי ארעא בחזקת אבהתא", ואמר רבא: "עדות מוכחשת היא". והשתא, מאי נפקא לן מינה? כיון דאמר רבא "מכאן ולהבא הוא נפסל", ה"נ היה לו לומר: למאי דאיתכחוש — איתכחוש, אבל לעדות של אבהתא, שהיה קודם שהוכחשו — לא! וה"נ גבי הזמה קאמר רבא גבי טביחה ומכירה: דהוזמו על הטביחה ולא על הגניבה — למאי דאיתזום איתזום; בהכחשה לא כ"ש?! וכ"ת: דהתם מיירי שתוך כדי דבור הוכחשו? והא מוכח אותה שמעתין דפרק מרובה (ב"ק דף עב: ושם) גבי טביחה ומכירה, דאפילו תוך כדי דבור לא מיפסלי למפרע אליבא דרבא! וי"ל: כיון שאותם שתי עדיות בקרקע אחת — הוי כעדות אחת, כדמפליג התם; אבל הכא, אף על פי שהוחזקו שקרנין על הטביחה, על הגניבה לא הוחזקו:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 27a:1:1.english: Rava says: He is disqualified from that point forward - It is astonishing: That which [the Gemara] says in the chapter [entitled] Chezkhat Habbatim (Bava Batra 31a and there): "This one says: '[It belonged to] my ancestors, and I occupied it for the years of presumptive ownership [chazakah],' and that one says, etc." This one brought witnesses that it was [the property] of his ancestors and he occupied it for the years of chazakah, and that one brought witnesses that he occupied it for the years of chazakah; and [the Gemara] says there: Let the [testimonies regarding] chazakah stand against the [other testimony regarding] chazakah, and establish the land in the presumptive ownership of the ancestors; and Rava said: "This is contradicted testimony!" And now, what difference does it make to us? Since Rava says [here that] he is disqualified from that point forward, so too he should have said [there]: With regard to that which they were contradicted, they are contradicted; but with regard to the testimony of ancestral ownership, which was before they were contradicted, no [they should not be disqualified]! And likewise regarding refutation as conspiring witnesses [hazamah], Rava says regarding slaughter and sale where they were refuted as conspiring witnesses concerning the slaughter but not concerning the theft: With regard to that which they were refuted as conspiring witnesses, they were refuted; regarding contradiction, is it not an a fortiori conclusion [kal vaḥomer]?! And if you should say that there it is dealing with a case where they were contradicted within the time required for an utterance [tokh kedei dibbur]? But behold, that sugya in the chapter [entitled] Merubah (Bava Kamma 72b and there) regarding slaughter and sale proves that even within the time required for an utterance they are not disqualified retroactively according to Rava! And it can be answered: Since those two testimonies pertain to one piece of land, it is considered as one testimony, as [the Gemara] distinguishes there; but here, even though they were established as liars regarding the slaughter, they were not established [as liars] regarding the theft.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 27a:3:1.hebrew: אין לך בו אלא חידושו - משמע דהחידוש הוי ממה שאני פוסל את הראשונים. תימה: דהתם (ב"ב דף לא:) קאמר: "לימא רבא דאמר כרב חסדא, דאמר: בהדי סהדי שקרי למה לי", ומפסלי שתי העדות, אפי' בהוכחשו בעלמא, דמכחשי אהדדי תרווייהו פסולי; ואם כן, מאי חידוש הוא גבי הזמה אי פסלינן עדים הראשונים? ויש לומר: דלמאי דבעי למימר התם מעיקרא דרבא סבירא ליה דרב חסדא, היינו ללישנא דפסידא דלקוחות. וי"מ: דהא דקאמר הכא "חידוש" — לאו אפסולא דקמאי קאי, אלא אהכשירא דבתראי; כלומר, היה לנו לפוסלן, כל שתי כיתות, וכיון דאיכא חידוש, לא ילפינן — אף לגבי הפסול — לפוסלן כלל הראשונים למפרע. וכי האי גוונא אמרינן פרק גיד הנשה (חולין דף צט ושם): דלא ילפינן דטעם כעיקר מבשר בחלב, משום דאיכא בו חידוש בהתירו; דהא אי תרו ליה בחלבא כולי יומא — שרי, ובבישול חדא שעה — אסור:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 27a:3:1.english: "You have in it only its novelty" - This implies that the novelty is that we disqualify the first [witnesses]. [This is] puzzling: For there (Bava Batra 31b), [the Gemara] says: "Shall we say that Rava said [his ruling] in accordance with Rav Chisda, who said: Why do I need these lying witnesses?" — and both sets of testimony are disqualified; even in [a case of] mere contradiction, where they contradict one another, both are disqualified. And if so, what novelty is there regarding conspiring witnesses [hazamah] if we disqualify the first witnesses? And one can say: That according to what [the Gemara] initially sought to say there, that Rava holds in accordance with Rav Chisda, that is according to the version [explaining Rava's reason as] due to the loss of purchasers. And some explain: That that which [the Gemara] says here, "a novelty" — it does not refer to the disqualification of the first [pair], but rather to the validation of the latter [pair]; that is to say, we ought to have disqualified them, both pairs [of witnesses], and since there is a novelty, we do not derive — even regarding the disqualification — to disqualify the first [witnesses] at all retroactively. And in a similar vein, we say in the chapter [entitled] Gid HaNasheh (Chullin 99a and there): That we do not derive that flavor is like the substance itself [ta'am ke'ikkar] from meat in milk, because there is a novelty in it in its permitted state; for if one soaks it in milk all day, it is permitted, but with boiling for a single hour, it is forbidden.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 27a:5:1.hebrew: דאסהידו בי תרי בחד ותרי בחד - וקשה לר"ת: חדא — דמאי קאמר "דאסהידו בי תרי בחד ותרי בחד", ומשום הכי ליכא חידוש? הא תרי כמאה! ועוד — דמאי קאמר "דפסלינהו בגזלנותא"? הא לא הוי מעין פלוגתייהו כלל, דפליגי בהזמה, ולא שייך "איכא בינייהו" אלא מעין פלוגתייהו! ועוד — ד"עדים זוממין" מבעי ליה לעיל למימר, כיון דאמרת תרי בחד ותרי בחד; ואמאי נקט "עד זומם"? ונראה לר"ת דגרסינן: "דאסהידו תרי [בחד]" ותו לא, שלא הוזם כי אם האחד. והשתא ניחא, דלהכי נקיט לעיל "עד זומם" — לשון יחיד; וניחא נמי הא דמהני תרי המזימים טפי מההוא חד, ולאו חידוש הוא. וגרסינן נמי: "דפסליה בגזלנותא", פירוש: דאחד נפסל בגזלנותא והשני הוזם, והשתא הוה מעין פלוגתייהו קצת:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 27a:5:1.english: "Where two testified about one, and two about one" - And it is difficult according to Rabbeinu Tam: First, what is [the Gemara] saying [when it explains that the case is] "where two testified about one, and two about one," and [that] because of this there is no novelty? But two [witnesses] are like a hundred! Furthermore, what is [the Gemara] saying [when it suggests]: "Where they disqualified them through robbery"? For this is not at all of the nature of their dispute, as they are arguing about [conspiring witnesses through] hazamah, and [a practical difference] "between them" is applicable only [when it is] of the nature of their dispute! Furthermore, [the Gemara] should have said earlier "conspiring witnesses" [in the plural], since you say [the case is where] two [testified] about one and two about one; so why did it use [the term] "a conspiring witness" [in the singular]? And it appears to Rabbeinu Tam that we read: "Where two testified [about one]" and no more — that only one [of the witnesses] was rendered a conspiring witness. And now [it is] well understood that this is why it used earlier [the term] "a conspiring witness" in the singular; and it is also well understood that the two refuting witnesses are more effective than that single [witness], and it is not a novelty. And we also read: "Where they disqualified him through robbery" — meaning that one was disqualified through robbery and the second was rendered a conspiring witness; and now it is somewhat of the nature of their dispute.
